learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge in environmental and related engineering topics; ability to apply this knowledge in the preparation and review assessment of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) reports.
Ability to identify, formulate, and solve complex engineering problems; ability to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.
Ability to develop, select, and use modern techniques and tools required for EIA applications; proficiency in effectively using information technologies
Ability to collect data for the examination of environmental problems, and to analyze and interpret the results.
Ability to work effectively in intra-disciplinary teams.
Proficiency in Turkish verbal and written communication; writing reports effectively and understanding of written reports.
Awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning; ability to access information, monitor developments in science and technology, and renew him/herself continuously.
Knowledge about professional and ethical responsibility.
Knowledge about the effects of engineering practices on health, environment, and security at universal and societal dimensions and the problems that are reflected in the engineering field of the era.
Awareness of the legal consequences of engineering solutions.
Knowledge of technical regulations used in EIA applications.

syllabus_topics: An overview of the EIA definition, development and features of EIA legislation in the world and Turkey
planning and management of EIA study
Identification of the affected environment and the indicators used in this definition
prediction and assesment of impacts on air environment
prediction and assesment of impacts on surface environment
prediction and assesment of impacts on soil and groundwater environment
prediction and assesment of impacts on noise environment
prediction and assesment of impacts on on the biological environment
prediction and assesment of visual impacts
prediction and assesment of impacts on the cultural and socioeconomic environment
Review and Evaluation, Monitoring and control.
